desc:
🎈 A realistic ragdoll physics simulation engine ! + VR Support (Virtual Reality)

⏳ LAST UPDATE: Halloween Update 🎃 ZOMBIES! 🧟 Gather 3 of your friends to trigger the Zombie Apocalypse event near the rocketship! Can you survive?! 😱💀

SAFE MODE: Just tap on the shield on the left side of your screen ! 🛡

Anti-Gravity Controls:
💻 PRESS 'R' ON DESKTOP
🎮 PRESS 'B' ON XBOX

💻 Instructions for PC users:
Press 'F' to ragdoll your character
Press 'T' for first person
Press 'R' for Anti-Gravity

🎮 Instructions for XBOX:
Press Button 'X' to ragdoll your character
Press Button 'Y' for first person
Press Button 'B' for Anti-Gravity

🕶 To move in VR:
Use your right joy stick and right hand to aim where you want to go

❗❗ MORE EXCITING UPDATES COMING SOON ❗❗
